<reason>B won the expectations and tradeoff comparison. A's 1970s spiral was neutralized by B's 2021-22 counter that 8-9% inflation fell without a spiral while expectations stayed anchored, and B's 1% vs 100% scarring arithmetic outweighed A's everyone-vs-some framing. B's pressure forced A to define modest and concede stopping when anchored, letting B frame the remainder as ECB-2011 style holding.</reason>
